dash.lede: Here is where your projects stand.
dash.noProjectsBody: Start with an AI estimate from a client brief, or create a project.

onb.s1b: A few details so your scopes look like you. You can change all of this later in Settings.
onb.name: Your name
onb.businessHint: Clients see this on every scope.
onb.s2b: We use this for dates, numbers and the currency your scopes start in.
onb.s3b: Your rate prices AI estimates. Payment details show to clients after they approve.
onb.payInsHint: Bank transfer, PromptPay, bKash or a note. Shown after a client approves.
onb.notifySigned: a client signs or asks for changes
onb.s4b: Add a client and a project now, or start from a client's brief.

proj.title: Title
proj.noEstimates: No estimate yet. Paste the client brief into the AI estimator.
proj.noDocuments: Send a scope for your client to approve line by line and sign.
proj.deleteBody: This removes its estimates, documents, payments and files. Links you sent keep working for your client, but they won’t show here.

pay.never: Your client pays you directly. SignedScope never holds money.
pay.label: What for
pay.markBody: Record a payment you received. Add a reference, like a bank transfer ID, if you have one.

files.blocked: {{name}}: this file type can’t be stored
files.shareCopied: Download link copied. It works for 7 days.
files.deleteBody: The file is removed for good. Share links stop working.
files.noneBody: Keep briefs, contracts, designs and invoices for this project here. Only you can see them unless you share a link.

cli.name: Name
cli.countryHint: Two letters, like TH or BD
cli.noneBody: Add the people you work for. Their projects, scopes and payments stay together.
cli.noProjects: No projects with this client yet.
cli.deleteBody: Their projects stay, without a client.

set.mfaIntro: Choose how you sign in (Google, GitHub or email) and turn on two-step sign-in with an authenticator app.
set.exportBody: Download everything in your workspace as a JSON file.

q.title: Client questions
q.hint: Your client sees your answer under the line when they open the link again. To change the scope itself, send a new revision.

auth.title: Sign in or create your workspace
auth.lede: Clients, projects, estimates, signed scopes and payments in one place. Free during the beta.
auth.offBody: You can still use the AI estimator and create a scope link without an account.
auth.agree: By continuing you agree to how we handle data in the
auth.loadError: Sign-in could not load. Check your connection and refresh the page.

doc.payNote: Payment goes straight to {{agency}} through {{host}}. SignedScope never handles the money.
doc.cutOff: These links are long. If part of it was cut off when it was copied, ask the sender to share it again.

sign.missing: Part of this link is missing.
sign.notDoc: This is not a sign-off link.
sign.unverified: This link was made without a SignedScope account, so the sender’s name and email are not verified. Check with them before you pay.
sign.crBanner: Change request against “{{title}}”, signed by {{signer}} on {{when}}. Colored bars show added and changed lines.
sign.totalHint: Rejecting a priced line removes it from the total.
sign.name: Your full name
sign.agree: I’ve reviewed every line above. My decisions are a record of what I approve for this project, and I understand out-of-scope lines are not included.
sign.agreeTerms: I agree to the terms of this agreement.
sign.recorded: Your name, email, the time, your country and a short browser fingerprint are recorded in the receipt and sent to the sender.
sign.undecided_one: Decide 1 more line before you sign.
sign.undecided_other: Decide {{count}} more lines before you sign.
sign.doneBody: Save this receipt link. It’s the signed record of your decisions, and the sender gets a copy.

q.label: Your question
q.question: Q:
q.waiting: Waiting for an answer from the sender.
q.sent: Question sent. The sender gets an email, and their answer shows here when you open this link again.

receipt.notReceipt: This is not a receipt link.
receipt.verifyHint: Check this receipt on the verify page
receipt.meta: Signed by {{name}}{{email}} ({{client}}) on {{when}} · prepared by {{agency}} · revision {{revision}}
receipt.notLegal: A record of what was approved, not a qualified electronic signature.
receipt.howToVerify: To check this record, open {{url}} and paste the receipt link. SignedScope confirms the link was issued by it and that nothing in it has changed.

new.title: New scope
new.crBanner: Baseline: “{{title}}”, signed by {{signer}} on {{when}}. Edit the lines below. Your client sees what changed against this baseline.
new.crFailed: Could not load the signed receipt this change builds on: {{error}}
new.fromEstimate: Filled in from your AI estimate. Check every line and price before you send it.
new.signInToFile: Sign in to save this scope to your project.
new.paste: Paste the client’s message or brief
new.pasteHint: You review and price every line before anything is sent.
new.pastePh: Hey! Can we also add Apple Pay at checkout? And a size guide on product pages.
new.drafted_one: Added 1 line. Check the wording and add prices.
new.drafted_other: Added {{count}} lines. Check the wording and add prices.
new.draftedAi_one: Added 1 line (drafted by AI). Check the wording and add prices.
new.draftedAi_other: Added {{count}} lines (drafted by AI). Check the wording and add prices.
new.draftedNone: Nothing to add from that text.
new.itemsHint: Add a price to any line the client should approve with its cost. Paste a list into a line and each row becomes a line.
new.currencyLocked: Same currency as the signed scope, so totals compare.
new.payLinkHint: Stripe, Wise, PayPal, Payoneer or Omise. Your client sees a Pay button after approving.
new.payInsHint: Bank transfer, PromptPay, bKash and similar. Shown after your client approves.
new.readyBody: Send it to your client. This page keeps no copy, so keep the link.
new.filed: Saved to your project. You’ll see when your client opens and signs it.
new.depositHint: A share of the total your client approves. The rest becomes a balance request.
new.depositHintCr: A share of the increase your client approves over the signed scope.
new.depositNeedsPrice: Add a price to a line to ask for a deposit.

compose.partiesBody: This agreement is between {{me}} and {{client}} for the project “{{title}}”.
compose.nextBody: Review each line below, approve or comment, and sign. Work starts once the deposit is received.
compose.heading: Section {{n}} heading
compose.written: Draft written. Check it before sending.
compose.noEstimate: No estimate on this project yet. Add lines here, or run an AI estimate first.
compose.scheduleHint: Becomes payment requests in this project when your client approves.
compose.notLegal: These are plain-language templates, not legal advice, and no lawyer has reviewed them for your country. Read them, edit what doesn’t fit, and have a local lawyer check them for larger projects. The terms are written in English.
compose.needLines: Add at least one line for your client to approve.
compose.readyBody: Send it to your client. You’ll see here when they open and sign it, and the payment schedule becomes payment requests once they approve.

estimate.signInToSave: Sign in to save estimates and track clients
estimate.loadedSaved: Saved estimate loaded. Edit it and save again as a new version.
estimate.h1: Paste a brief. Get a quote you can defend.
estimate.lede: Features, user stories, milestones, timeline and a price range from your own rate. You edit everything before your client sees it.
estimate.briefPh: Paste what the client sent you. For example: "We need a website for our café with a menu, online booking and Instagram feed…"
estimate.privacy: Not stored. Sent to Claude (Anthropic) to estimate.
estimate.wait: Reading the brief and breaking it down… about 20–40 seconds.
estimate.sampleNote: Sample estimate for the sample brief. The AI estimator isn't switched on yet.
estimate.editHint: Change any hours or remove a line. Totals update as you go.
estimate.nextP: Turn this into a scope your client approves line by line and signs. Each feature becomes a priced line.
estimate.fbH: Would you send this estimate to a real client?
estimate.fbThanks: Thank you! This helps us improve.
estimate.disclaimer: Estimates are AI-generated starting points, not guarantees. Check them against your own experience before quoting.
estimate.formula: Hours × {{rate}}/h, plus {{buffer}}% buffer. Quote per feature uses the middle of each range.

verify.title: Verify a SignedScope link
verify.lede: Paste a sign-off or receipt link to check that SignedScope issued it and that nothing in it has changed.
verify.label: Link or code
